title.value: Joint Bayesian Inference of Graphical Structure and Parameters with a Single Generative Flow Network
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the main topic of the paper, which is the use of a single Generative Flow Network for joint Bayesian inference of both graphical structures and parameters.
title.quote: Joint Bayesian Inference of Graphical Structure and Parameters with a Single Generative Flow Network

extractions.description: This paper introduces JSP-GFN, a method for joint Bayesian inference of the structure and parameters of Bayesian Networks using a single Generative Flow Network (GFlowNet). It extends previous work on GFlowNets to continuous sample spaces, enabling the approximation of the joint posterior distribution of both the structure and parameters. The method is validated empirically on both simulated and real data, showing favorable results compared to existing methods.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on Bayesian inference using Generative Flow Networks for probabilistic models, without any direct reference to climate change or sustainability.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets), a class of generative models over discrete and structured sample spaces, have been previously applied to the problem of inferring the marginal posterior distribution over the directed acyclic graph (DAG) of a Bayesian Network, given observations.

primary_category.quote: In this paper, we propose to infer the joint posterior over graphical structures G and parameters of the conditional probability distributions θ of a Bayesian Network using a single GFlowNet (Bengio et al., 2021a;b) called JSP-GFN.
